nom: Philosophy Microdelivery Exfoliating Daily Facial Wash

avis.texte: I'm so glad this is offered in a travel size! I use this face wash weekly and it always makes my skin feel so soft and smooth!

Every morning I apply this wonderful facial wash, cleansing my face and leaving me feel super fresh and clean. Then after my shower, I move onto applying philosophy's Hope in a Jar and let the day begin.

I just love the smell and the feel of this exfoliate face wash. It has enough exfoliate without being too harsh. I continue to go back to this wash even if I try other brands etc. Truly the best! My preteen daughter uses it also without complaints!

avis.titre: Great fo the facial and body included.
avis.texte: I think once a week with this for the face with the Philosophy gentle cleansing product the rest of the week. The exfoliating cleanser can be used in the shower for your body daily or every few days for extremely smooth skin. Lotion your body with the Philosophy body lotion. You will be amazed.
I love this and use it every other day for a gentle scrub. Very gentle, and it has pleasant light scent.
This exfoliating wash is fantastic! Mild enough to use daily without drying out my skin. I use this and Purity facial cleanser as my daily routine. Wish you made a toner

Full disclosure: I have not tried it. I wanted to check the label for microplastics, a common ingredient in exfoliators. Yep. Acrylates copolymer = microplastics. I'm not perfect but trying to cut back on my plastic footprint where I can. Just FYI
Love the scent, love the way it gently exfoliates without being harsh
I love this face wash . It cleans my skin yet doesn't dry it out.
Gentle but effective cleanser. Love using in the morning before applying makeup.
This product is incredible. I have been using for years. Made a huge difference.
Product absorption is good. gentle on the body. radiance and smooth texture on the body
Have used this product for many years and love it more and more.

I use Philosophy Purity every day and have no problems.So I decided to try the micro delivery.It made my face turn red and break out.So I contacted the customer service and they said it was atypical which I felt was pretty rude! I cant imagine that I'm the only one who my skin did not like it. Then they wanted pictures of my face then fill out a questionnaire then take pictures of the bottle..And in SIX weeks if I have not heard from them to throw the product away! Way to much to have to do! I will purchase my Philosophy elsewhere! Where they appreciate my business and they won't tell me this is there policy! I should have never purchased on line from the company! Lesson learned!

avis.titre: Buy it- you'll have no regrets!!
avis.texte: I've found this to be very effective at cleaning and exfoliating. After use my skin feels brighter and healthier!

Generally speaking, I stay away from face scrubs preferring a liquid BHA exfoliating solution instead, but sometimes I just want a good facial scrub I can "feel." The Philosophy Exfoliating Daily Facial Wash exceeds all expectations. Most scrubs are too harsh on my sensitive skin (prone to redness), but Philosophy's microbeads are tiny and soft enough to deliver a gentle but effective facial scrub. I recommend using a washcloth or something to maximize the cleanser part of it, but using your hand is ok too. I keep this in the shower so now my husband loves using it too so it is good for both of our different skin types.

Bottle pump doesn't work. I like the face wash but for the price for non functioning equipment is wasteful and not a good value. This must be a known issue because a second pump was sent but it was too large for the bottle.
I have used this product every morning for over 15 years, probably closer to 20 years! At age 73, my skin looks refreshed and youthful!
Love this product. Been using this face wash for at least 3 years.
I feel I got scammed out of BOGO purchase of 16 oz daily facial cleanser
Love this subtle face wash to exfoliate my face every other day
This is the BEST exfoliating face wash I've ever used. Use it every night and gets rid of all the dead skin, cleans pores and prevents breakouts. I would never switch.
Been using this for years and my face loves it! Use daily in the morning and it really helps with fine lines and to cleanse pores.
The exfoliating daily facial wash is easy to use. The smell is nice and it washes off easily.
Love this as a part of my regular skincare. Gives a good scrub but not too aggressive. The bottle lasts a long time and the scent is mild

I have been using this face wash for years and I have only had great experiences. It is exfoliating but not harsh and I find it cool that it is made with diatoms-unicellular algae with shells made of glass.

avis.titre: I will get a large bottle!
avis.texte: I wanted to try a new some new face wash products, this is now my favorite! Clean polished finish and soft to the touch. I love it! Definitely would recommend especially if you wear makeup everyday.
I have very dry skin, and it's often sensitive to new products. Microdelivery cleans & exfoliates without drying my skin. I love the scent too!
I buy this product regularly because I love it but it's a 50/50 shot at getting one with a pump that works! So annoying!

avis.titre: Easy to use and not too harsh
avis.texte: Great for daily use. I've used this for years along with Purity cleanser.
I love this exfoliating scrub! I keep it in the shower and refill my 8 oz btl with this big one. It's very gentle but does a great job removing dead skin and stimulating my face and neck

Honestly, the product itself is great. It's a fine-grain exfoliant that really feels great on the skin and is not too rough. Unfortunately, the customer service (or lack thereof) is the reason I will not be a returning customer. My product came with a faulty pump; I called customer service asking for a replacement nozzle. They were unable to ship only a pump (understandable) and would have to send an entirely new replacement product (fine). The problem is, I had to return my product first, wait for it to be processed with quality control so they could "inspect" it, and then could receive my replacement. My product reached their facility on Thursday, 1/15 (I was told I was responsible for the tracking). After 9 days of no correspondence following the receipt of my product, I finally called back on Saturday, 1/24. No replacement product had been shipped my way, and the rep (albeit polite) was a bit nonchalant about the fact that I was completely product-less (though my credit card statement begs to differ). I even had to ask for rush shipping so I could finally enjoy my product sooner rather than later. It's just a customer service model I'm unfamiliar with; most companies would immediately send a replacement since it's a faulty product—- not force the customer to a) print the shipping label themselves and return it b) be responsible for the tracking and receipt of the item c) be responsible for the follow-up to ensure the company actually sends the replacement product d) wait

I use Purity face cleaner daily and Microdelivery every other day as my cleaners. I also use Hope in a Jar as a moisturizer. This is a great combination. I'm 56 years old and my face has never been cleaner and more healthy. My little mini spa at night really helps relax after a long day of work.

I have used exfoliating microdelivery for many years. I use it every night in my nightly cleansing routine. It really helps your skin to look better. I bought this trial size to use when I travel. Highly recommend.
I have used philosophy for many years to bottle was opened as though it was use product was oozing from the bottle which I thought all products were sealed
First time buying and using this. Recommend this! My face is a lot softer and clean
I really like the tiny micro beads in this product (not too aggressive). I only purchase when on sale as I think it is overpriced.

This product was recommended for me through Ulta's skin analysis tool. I've used it since July and its actually made my skin worse. It's caused breakouts and inflammation all over my face but especially my nose and chin. Really disappointing
Love how clean my skin feels with this product. Love to interchange with purity.

Who would have thought exfoliating would feel so good? I keep this in my shower to wash my face in the morning. It does a good job of gently exfoliating my skin. I'm not sure what the "beads" are, but they are NOT harsh on the skin. My face feels clean and refreshed after using.
I love this stuff! I am never without it. Its gentle and effective. I love that there is no fragrance!
It really exfoliates your skin. I can see the difference in my skin and it also moisturizes my face. My face feels like velvet
I had been out for a while, and it was amazing all the dead skin cells it eliminates from my face! Philosophy is revolutionizing skincare at its finest! I'm a true believe in this product!
I LOVE this daily exfoliate! I've tried using other products and none of them were as good as this one.

We LOVE this at our house. I originally bought it for myself but my husband tried it and will not go back. It's gentle scrubby beads and citrus scent are perfect! Not a super rough exfoliator, and since we are both fair with sensitive skin, it makes for a great way to exfoliate without damaging our skin.
Amazing exfoliate! Gentle on skin. Leaves skin soft and glowing.

I bought the biggest bottle and this on a whim cause I needed something that's for everyday. I am an 52 yrs young, I like That it's easy to use.That it exfoliating and cleans and smooths my older skin. Skin feels so soft afterwards. Recommend

I've tried many other facial cleaners trying to find a dupe or something that works just as well but always come to this product. Nothing compares. I have dry skin and it is gentle enough for everyday & can see a visible difference in my skin when I use this facial wash. 100% recommend.

DO NOT BUY THIS!!! I made the terrible mistake of not reading the ingredients until after this facewash ruined my skin. It contains Diatomaceous Earth as one of the top ingredients, which I literally use to kill bugs in my home. ABSOLUTELY NO. I started using it in the summer and noticed within a few weeks a rash on my chin. I assumed it was unrelated and from the summer weather but I now know that it was 100% this product as it only started to heal after I stopped using it (I changed nothing else in my routine). It took months for the red spot on my face to coear up and now in December there is still a faint redness where the rash occurred. I'm concerned it may never fully fade because it left a scar.
Best product from Philosophy. I have used this for over 20 yrs.
Gentle exfoliating cleanser that's perfect for my combo skin.
My husband has really sent skin and we discovered this cleanser works great for him. It has gentle exfoliation without over drying.
Love this stuff. And the pump bottle is better than the old one.

This isn't as gritty as the Dermalogica powder exfoliator I normally like & the grit seems to stick to my face after thorough rinsing & my face just doesn't feel entirely as smooth as when using Dermalogica. I plan to return this for what I normally like
I absolutely love how this cleanser makes my face looks and feels after using it. Making this one of my new favorite go-to products.
Microdelivery is one of my favorite products. It works so well on my sensitive skin.
Incredible product, my skin is so smooth & glowy after every use!

I have used this product for years and even had when I try other similar products, I always come back to this. It cleans so well and leaves my skin comfortable and radiant. I keep mine in the shower and use purity at my sink.

avis.titre: Love this face wash! Pump was broken though :(
avis.texte: I absolutely love love love this face wash so much but the pump came broken so I have to unscrew the lid everytime to get some which is a little frustrating.
Love using this in the shower! Skin is fresh and smooth! Have used this product for over 7 years!
I love this product, but my recent order was disappointing. The pump dispenser doesn't work! Its hard to get the product out.

Im amazed by how many people love this wash. I wouldn't recommend if you have normal to dry skin; this facial cleanser made my skin feel so dry, as if i used Dawn dishsoap to strip all oils from my skin. Not to mention the beads! They are nearly impossible to fully remove from your face, even when in the shower. I will give this product credit for not causing irritation and for making my skin very shiny and exfoliated. However, I strongly recommend this cleanser for those confronting oily skin.
I absolutely love this exfoliating cleanser. It smells divine and leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I love that it's gentle enough for everyday use.

Not particularly wowed by this product, but it cleanses well without leaving my combination skin stripped. I actually bought it for my husband, whose beard gets thick occasionally. He said he really enjoys it. He has very average skin, a few noticeable pores on his nose, but no other skin concerns.

I've actually never left a review for a product before but feel i have to with this one. I swear by philosophy's purity face wash so i thought id try this when it was on sale. It is EXTREMELY abrasive. Felt like i was rubbing sandpaper on my skin. I am shook it says "daily facial wash" ..couldn't be me

avis.titre: A gentle yet effective daily exfoliating wash that
avis.texte: really enjoy using the Philosophy Microdelivery exfoliating daily facial wash. The texture is gentle yet effective – the micro-exfoliating beads are fine enough not to irritate my skin but still leave it feeling smooth and refreshed. The scent is very light and clean, which makes it pleasant to use every day without being overwhelming. The packaging is simple, sturdy, and convenient with a pump that dispenses just the right amount of product, making it hygienic and easy to use. In terms of value for money, I find it worth the price because a little goes a long way, and the bottle lasts for months with daily use. Most importantly, the effectiveness is impressive – it helps keep my skin looking brighter, smoother, and clearer without stripping it of moisture. Overall, it's a great product that I would definitely recommend.
Placed an order of this by mistake and they have a 0 cancellation policy. What a rip off! Will never be ordering from this site again.

This little exfoliator is great!! Packaging is sleek and clean first of all. And it has these little beads in it which really helps clean up all the dirt and dead skin on your face. I feel great after using it and it smells so so good too !!!

After one use, it left red, warm, irritated, flaky patches on my face that took three days to clear up. I do have somewhat sensitive skin, but I figured something intended for daily use would be gentle enough. I returned it.

I received this product free in exchange for my honest review. This fave wash works well. It leaves my face feeling and looking fresh and clean. It exfoliates well and makes the skin feel very soft and smooth. The soap lathers well and smells great. I really like using this and a few days out of the week for the exfoliation

I started using this due to cystic acne on my chin years ago and have used it ever since. I use it every third or fourth day on my face, neck and the backs of my hands. I even take it on vacation. I always have a bottle in the shower and a new one ready for when I run out.
I have used this for years and I use it every night. It has just the right amount of exfoliation and it smells like a light lemon. It keeps my pores clean and my face is great!!

I've been using the Philosophy Microdelivery Exfoliating Face Wash and I'm obsessed! ✨ In my opinion there's something so satisfying about a gentle scrub that really makes your skin feel fresh. One pump is all you need, it's got the perfect amount of grit to smooth out texture and clean away dirt without being harsh. When you add water it foams up beautifully, and there's a light citrusy scent (that disappears after rinsing). My skin feels super clean, never dry, and I've noticed such a nice glow after using it daily for about a month. 🌟 Definitely a keeper, I'll be repurchasing for sure! 💛

I really love this face wash. It has a really nice fresh scent and after using makes you feel refreshed. I love how it's a pump bottle. I use this every night before bed and it makes my face feel really clean. Once out will by again.

Philosophy exfoliating daily facial wash has been a long time favorite of mine. The exfoliating grains are very fine and is an excellent physical exfoliant. However, I do not use this daily maybe 2 to 3 times a week to help clear my pores.

This is a very good exfoliating facial wash. I really like the refreshing orange scent. Although the micro-exfoliating beads are gentle enough to use daily, I have sensitive skin, so I use this wash every other day. My face feels very clean and smooth after each wash. I do not understand why the instructions on the back only mention using this in the morning.

I've been using this face wash for over a decade and I just adore it. It's great for when my skin needs a refresh and to remove a lot of dead skin. The small granules really smooth everything out, and my skin is left glowy and prepped for skincare and makeup!
I received this product from influencer in return for my incentivized review. I love the gentle smell and that its not too gritty. Leaves skin smooth and clean.

avis.titre: Simple and effective exfoliating face wash!
avis.texte: I think this might be a little bit too harsh for my skin because I have sensitive skin but overall, I think it does a good job exfoliating. It's just not something I can use on a regular basis, maybe once a week. But the texture was good. It smelled fine And it did the job so if you're looking for an exfoliating face wash, this is a great one!

avis.titre: Such a good face wash, gritty but leaves you feeli
avis.texte: I absolutely love this exfoliating daily face wash from Philosophy! I feel like chemical exfoliants have taken all of the hype the last few years, but there is something about a gentle but gritty physical exfoliant that can't be beat. One pump goes a long way, the texture is perfectly gritty to take away texture and dirt but does not irritate at all. It froths up very nicely once you add water, and there is a light citrus scent that I find goes away once you rinse! My face has felt so fresh and looks so much brighter after using this consistently once a day for nearly a month. The wash isn't stripping at all but leaves your face feeling super clean. Overall I love this product and will definitely repurchase.
Use in the morning. The gentle citrus scent was a nice way to refresh and the exfoliation was super gentle, not harsh or abrasive. This was a pleasant addition to my routine.

I typically am not a fan of anything that claims to be exfoliating, but this is some amazing face wash. The wash itself has a grainy texture but is smooth on your face. A little goes a loooong way! It doesn't dry you out or leave you feeling sticky. The pump makes it easy to use and I feel like my skin is brighter. I also have not experience any break outs since receiving this. I will definitely rebuy this
No scent noted, feels gentle yet slight gritty texture, to exfoliate effectively, pump works well. Foams and lathers well. Leaves skin soft,.
Love everything about this! The smell is amazing and it truly made my skin feel amazing. I might make the switch to this brand moving forward!!!!

I like that it is an exfoliate and a DAILY cleanser. I don't mind the fine grit feeling it gives because I feel like it's getting all the days dirt off my face and taking off the dead skin cells of the day as well. However, those with sensitive skin may not want to do this everyday. There is no strong scent and your skin feels great after.

avis.titre: Micro grains that do great work!
avis.texte: I enjoy a good exfoliating face wash, this one in particular I really enjoyed! I liked that while the actual grains in this product are really micro they didn't feel like they disappeared once I started rubbing it on my face. It had a nice light citrusy scent, not overpowering at all. It feels like it does a great job at really removing all of the built up dead skin cells (gross!) without feeling like it's stripping the skin or being harsh.
Love this wash! It's gritty but not too fine but the grit dissolves like sugar! No hard plastic beads that tear up your skin. Face feels smooth and polished after

i could go on and on about this stuff. it's gentle. it doesn't break our my sensitive acne prone skin. it smells so gentle and not fake like. my skin LOVES it and it feels so smooth yet hydrated after use!
Have been using this product of 10 years and have seen significant improvement in my skin

Really loved this face soap. Definitely an exfoliant but not a strong scrub. For sure great to use daily. I really liked the thick texture as well. I do wish the bottle came in a smaller size. My most favorite thing is that the squirt lid can be closed back and sealed for better safety during travel! Overall this was a great product and I would for sure consider purchasing again.

Wasn't sure about using an exfoliating wash, but after trying the sample I received in an order, I'm loving it! Feels so good, and makes my face feel smooth and clean. I don't use every day, but it feels wonderful and doesn't dry my skin. I don't notice a strong scent either, which I like.
Effective scrub that removed dead skin without the harsh scrubbing. Love that it has a pump and smells great. Not too strong but still leaves your skin fresh and feeling clean.

I love this cleanser! The diatomaceous earth exfoliates my skin while still leaving it soft! It's not too rough or gritty on the skin which I like because sometimes traditional exfoliating cleansers can tear the skin. This is the perfect gentle everyday exfoliating cleanser.

Highly recommend. The wash has small bead like texture mixed in that is great for a true exfoliation. I am obsessed with using this in the morning; leaves your skins super soft No strong scent but does have a pleasant odor.
Mix feeling for me. But I guess it not bad or too good. But I know it doesnot give me to dryness feeling after I use it. Will try to use it another 2 weeks then maybe I can change my mind.
I got a sample for free and was hooked! I love the feel of the cleanser, it has a gentle sandy like feel that cleanses very well. Doesnt make the face feel too dry after washing!

This face wash has a bright, citrusy scent that's perfect for mornings—it really helps wake you up. But even though the label says it's gentle enough for sensitive skin and daily use, I'm not so sure. The micro-exfoliating beads feel a little rough, and personally, I don't think you should be exfoliating your face every single day, especially with a physical scrub. I actually use this a few times a week, usually at night. It makes more sense to me as a nighttime product since it's exfoliating, but the scent definitely gives off morning vibes. I don't have sensitive skin, so when I do use it, I really enjoy it—my skin feels soft and looks more radiant afterward. It's a nice product overall, just not something I'd reach for every day.
Surprised how delighted I was with the results. Love this product!

I like this face wash but I would say it is not for daily use. I think it is a little too harsh to use every day but when you need a good exfoliation it's a great option. However, I did struggle with the pump not working I ended up having to unscrew the top to get to the product.
Products on my home shelf are a must for travel! I use the microdelivery 4 times a week. I prefer the miracle with the sun screen.

I have been using this product for YEARS and I will never be without it! For those of us that grew up thinking an exfoliating scrub had to feel like sandpaper to be effective, this product is a welcome relief...it does a wonderful job of cleansing, polishing, and refreshing your face without feeling harsh or damaging. I use this every other day and especially when I've used a physical sunscreen as I feel it really helps remove the zinc oxide residue that can linger on skin. LOVE, LOVE, LOVE!!!
I was usuing this product but I couldn't take a photo I completely forgot and I meant to write this sooner but it is a good product I don't use it everyday only like twice a week.

This exfoliating facial wash is awesome! It's gentle but really gets rid of dry skin and leaves my face feeling super smooth and fresh. I love the light scent, and it doesn't dry me out. Feels like a mini spa moment every time I use it. Definitely a go-to now!
Been using this for years, gentle enough to use every day. Greatly improved my skins condition

avis.titre: Skin feels wonderful after using product!
avis.texte: Great for renewing your skin! Love that product has improved using the desert sand. Easier on the skin!
Smooth but yet is an exfoliant. Love how fresh and clean my face feels!
Obsessed with the refreshing scent and the texture of this stuff, it feels so clean and smooth after exfoliating with it. Definitely a new favorite of mine, it's gentle and effective.

I was surprised by the viscosity but glad it spreads effortlessly. Fragrance-free but still has a refreshing citrus scent from natural ingredients. The fine grains gently exfoliates and smooths away uneven texture. Lathers well. Does an excellent job cleansing my combination, towards oily, skin. Rinses off easily. My face didn't feel tight or taut after. Rather it's soft, smooth and hydrated. Appearance is brighter and more healthy-looking. While it didn't irritate, I plan to use this 3 times a week and not daily because I don't want to risk damaging my skin barrier. Pump is convenient to dispense cleanser. Worth the above average price.

avis.titre: Great micro-exfolian for every day use!
avis.texte: This is a really good exfoliator! With that said, my skin is very sensitive and maybe I rubbed a little too hard. Unfortunately, this product didn't work for me. HOWEVER, my daughter used it and loved it! It made her skin glow. It doesn't really have much of a scent, which is helpful for those avoiding strong fragrances. It has tons little micro crystals to really help unclog pores and wash away dead skin.

avis.titre: Really like this product! Highly recommend
avis.texte: The packaging is good and I love the scrub texture of this product! The scent is a nice refreshing lemon scent. The effectiveness is good and it's worth the value of money.
This works so well and smells great. I double cleanse and this is perfect if you do or don't and will leave you feeling really clean and not make your skin react in any way

Ive been using the Philosophy Microdelivery Exfoliating Face Wash for a week or so now and I do like it! The texture is gentle but just the right amount of exfoliation without being too harsh. It leaves my face feeling incredibly smooth and refreshed. I've incorporated a daily exfoliate into my routine a while ago, as it's important when using other products to be able to fully penetrate into the skin. I did not have any negative reaction to this. The scent is light and pleasant. I didn't breakout and my skin didn't become too dry when using with my current routine. Overall, it's a great option if you're looking for a gentle exfoliating wash that can be used frequently. I would recommend!
I love how gentle it is on my skin and the smoothing results if gives me. Definitely will buy again and recommend

avis.titre: Mini spa day in a bottle
avis.texte: I have combination skin and appreciate a good exfoliant that I can actually feel but isn't too gritty. This fine grain is the perfect amount where I can feel the scrubbing but at the same time it's gentle. The scent is a light fresh-citrus scent that smells delicious. I would recommend this to anyone looking for an exfoliating cleanser!
Perfect size for travel. I like to but the 32 oz bottles to save money. I can use these to refill as necessary. Now I never have to go without.

This is perfect for an every day exfoliator. My skin felt so smooth after using just one time! I wouldn't recommend for taking off eye makeup as it can be a little harsh around the eyes. But such a great product that I will be implementing in my morning skin care routine!

I use facial scrub at least two times a week- especially in the summer when I am hot, sweaty and grimy feeling. This Philosophy exfoliating wash is the best one I have ever used - and I have tried a lot! It is scent free, gentle, and makes my skin feel so soft. I gently rub it for maybe about 20-25 seconds until I feel I like it "melts" a little and rinse thoroughly. There is no sticky after feel and I haven't noticed any additional redness. I do NOT use it on days when I know I am going swimming or to the beach. I usually use it at night in the summer and daytime in the winter. I have just purchased. Second bottle. The first has about a quarter left in it and I have had it for 8 months or so. I use this other places besides my face as well. It has caused no adverse reactions at all and my skin is pretty sensitive. I have other body scrubs - Sol De Jenero's number 40 is my all time favorite- but I use this face on just on spots that might be dirty (like my knees) or are really itchy. I want to add that I am 52 and have dry, sensitive skin. I have not been paid to say anything! I really love this product!
